@@U00341@@
I speak only the modest truth, sir. And yet men, that foolish congregation of petty microcosms, insist on calling themselves whole entities. As for me, I’m a part of that Part that at first was All, a part of the darkness that gave birth to light, arrogant light that competes with Night for her ancient rank and ancient space. But it won't succeed, struggle as it may. Light is one with objects. Light flows from bodies, it gives bodies beauty, and yet bodies check it in its course. And so, I trust, it won't be long till light and the physical world go down to dark destruction.

@@U00343@@
Yes, I begin to grasp it, your worthy occupation! Unable to annihilate wholesale, you've made a stab at it retail.

@@U00345@@
Yes, and a lot of good it’s done me. Empty hands is all I have. This Something, this lump of a world, this mess, for all the inroads I've made on it with my Nothing, does nothing but oppose me tooth and nail. What good have flood and fire, earthquake and storms done me? Nothing! Land and sea are as unshaken as ever. And as for that damnable brood of men and animals,
translation:
@@U00341@@
我只说最朴实的事实，先生。然而，人类，这个由微小的微观世界组成的愚蠢的群体，却坚持称自己为完整的实体。至于我，我是最初是全部的那个部分的一部分，是诞生了光的黑暗的一部分，傲慢的光，与黑夜争夺她古老的地位和古老的空间。但它不会成功，尽管可能会挣扎。光与物体合一。光从身体流出，它赋予身体美丽，但身体却在其过程中检查它。因此，我相信，用不了多久，光明和物质世界就会陷入黑暗的毁灭。

@@U00343@@
是的，我开始明白了，你值得从事的职业！由于无法消灭批发，你已经尝试了零售。

@@U00345@@
是的，这对我有很多好处。我两手空空。这个东西，这个世界的肿块，这个混乱，尽管我用我的“无”取得了所有的进展，但除了竭尽全力地反对我之外，什么也没有做。洪水、火灾、地震和风暴对我有什么好处呢？没有什么！陆地和海洋一如既往地没有动摇。至于那群该死的人类和动物，
